introduction: Rhode Island WIC provides selected nutritious foods, nutrition support and breastfeeding services for eligible participants.
description: Rhode Island WIC provides selected nutritious foods, nutrition support and breastfeeding services for eligible participants.

sections.who: Eligible groups include pregnant and breastfeeding participants, postpartum participants up to six months, infants and children younger than five. The local agency checks the full eligibility rules.
sections.get: Participation has no charge. Benefits cover an assigned food package rather than all groceries.
sections.docs:

  • Pregnancy or child records needed for certification.
sections.apply:
1. Find intake

    Use Find A WIC Agency on Rhode Island WIC.

  2. Arrange certification

    Ask what to bring and who must attend the appointment.

  3. Complete assessment

    The clinic reviews eligibility and explains benefits and follow-up visits.
sections.after: Use the WIC Shopper app for participant information and contact your clinic about benefit questions.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Rhode Island WIC. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Can a parent apply for a child?
Any parent or guardian can request enrollment for a child younger than five.
The state says participation is free.
Does WIC cover every grocery item?
No. It supplies assigned approved foods.
Is a prescreen a final decision?
The local agency must review eligibility.
